verification.identityProof: Real signed Better Auth cookies and PostgreSQL control API before real verified TLS app HTTP

limitations: Fixed registered runtime composition, not authoritative runtime registration, a process entry point, native listener or AWS ingress.
Pending control RPCs remain deadline-bound; retirement discards results, and undistributed callback sessions can expire normally.
Fresh authorization occurs at HTTP request admission, not repeatedly during a bounded response; delivered bytes cannot be revoked.
Native listener cancellation/backpressure/global caps, WS, certificate provisioning and direct-origin denial remain required.
Full Doctor >=95, wake/idle/budget, data/secrets/quotas, UI/tools and hosted acceptance remain unmet.
